text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Royce and Royce received an offer to 
appear on a show. I was reviewing the 
proposal sent by the producers, but—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. "Royce-chan Out and About 
(Tentative)." This could definitely be 
used to appeal with all kinds of cuteness!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If it's well-received, we'll do a second 
and third installment. So, as for the 
proposal for the first round—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Whaaaat?!?!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"A test of courage at a notoriously 
haunted spot at night"?! O-Of all things, 
right off the bat?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Of course I am! Not that I'm proud of it, 
but I've got trauma!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Back in elementary school, I was 
always the reliable, popular kid, but then 
I broke down crying at a test of courage 
and my whole reputation shattered... The 
memories...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not an option. Because there is 
a very clear advantage to this scene.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Horror content is known for drawing 
attention through reactions. As the 
kick-off for a new project, it's extremely 
effective for capturing fans' hearts. 
Truly professional.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
............ ...No... hmm. ...If I start 
letting out weird shrieks, all my 
self-branding up until now will be 
ruined...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Aaaah~! What should I do!? Me!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
“...... No. My mind is already made up. I 
can't let my self-producing grind to a 
halt here!”

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! It's training to overcome our 
fears! I'll make sure... this project is 
an absolute success!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, after spending several days 
immersed in a certain 'special training,' 
the day of the event arrived, but—"

text_block_list.name: Show Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Now, this road is notorious in the area 
for its haunting rumors— An eerie 
atmosphere hangs in the air even before 
entering, but how will Royce-chan 
fare...?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, s-so scary...! I'm... really bad with 
ghosts...! Still, I'll do my b—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle rustle)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
“...... I-Is it an animal? Like a 
squirrel... I-It'd be nice if it was a 
squirrel, huh... Ahaha...!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Royce and Royce, always reacting strictly 
within the bounds of "cute." Behind this 
lies a heartbreaking amount of effort—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Then Trainer-san. Horror Situation C. A 
"suspicious voice"—if you please.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Kya, wh-what!? A leopard!? A tiger!? 
...Wait, maybe I'm playing dumb a bit too 
much.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...I need to prepare 'perfectly cute 
reactions' in advance for every possible 
terrifying situation.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If only I can master that... I can pull 
off this upcoming project in the best way 
possible!!
choice_data_list: ...Will it really go that well, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'll put it to use! That's the producer 
spirit! Come on, we're not done yet! 
Today, we're going all the way up to 
"Situation K"!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Did someone just stroke my back— Oh, 
it was just... the wind. Sorry... ahaha~.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Fufufu... It's going smoothly so far. At 
this rate, I can imprint a reaction that 
stays strictly within the 'cute' zone—)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, huh? Huh? Why'd it suddenly get so 
much darker around here...)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Oooaaahhhh!?!?

text_block_list.name: Accompanying Staff
text_block_list.text: "...U-Um... Are you all right, Royce-san?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...... Wh-What was that...!? That loud 
voice just now...!?

text_block_list.name: Accompanying Staff
text_block_list.text:
Huh, well... Wasn't Royce-san the one 
shouting loudly?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Huh, no way!? There's no way I could make 
such a deep, gruff voice, right? Do I look 
like I could?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You can't see it, can you? ...That is—the 
reality.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Awawa... Could it be... a real 
ghost...? Th-That's so scary... B-But I 
have to do my best...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And... though there were a few close calls 
along the way, Royce and Royce somehow 
managed to pull through with "cute" 
reactions—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh. I'm just glad that somehow the 
fans seemed to love it too."
choice_data_list:
……You muscled through with a pro's wit and 
guts, huh.

……You muscled through with a pro's wit and 
guts, didn't you.

Is this also the magic of 
self-producing... maybe?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
A second installment is confirmed, too. 
I'd like to say 'all's well that ends 
well,' but...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Now that I remember it, it's getting 
scary again. N-Next time, I need to 
actively participate in the planning 
meeting and make sure we ban horror 
themes...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As long as you manage your 
self-production properly, there's no path 
you can't forge!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Even so... I've had quite enough of 
ghosts for a while."
